rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACwhenu
Exhibition name: Derek Nimmo
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1975).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Mattocks Roses / Notcutts as 'Derek Nimmo'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, silver(y) reverse. Moderate fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
